title: EVENTTHING Venue Library — venues.public.csv
description: One record of `data/venues.public.csv` (3,549 rows, 17 columns). Empty CSV cells are `null`; numbers are stored as CSV text and MUST be coerced before validation. Encoding: UTF-8 without BOM, LF. See `fields.md`.

master_id.title: master_id
master_id.description: Unique venue ID (e.g. BJ001). Primary key.

name_en.title: name_en
name_en.description: English venue name where the source publishes one; blank otherwise (641 of 3,549 rows).

category.title: category
category.description: Venue category: `商业` (commercial), `酒店` (hotel), `会展` (exhibition/convention), `体育` (sports), `特殊景点场地` (scenic/special site).

sub_type.title: sub_type
sub_type.description: Finer type as recorded, e.g. `商场` (mall), `商业地产场地` (commercial property), `酒店会议设施` (hotel meeting facilities), `展览中心`, `体育场`.

country.title: country
country.description: Country in Chinese. All rows in this release are `中国`.

province.title: province
province.description: Province or municipality in Chinese; blank when not recorded.

district.title: district
district.description: District in Chinese; blank when not recorded.

address.title: address
address.description: Street address in Chinese as published.

source_url.title: source_url
source_url.description: Public source page for the record. Commercial venues are blank by policy: third-party deep links are not redistributed. 421 of 3,549 rows carry a URL.

lng.title: lng
lng.description: WGS-84 longitude. Commercial venues are blank by policy. 656 of 3,549 rows carry a point.

status.title: status
status.description: Operating status: `open`, `closed`, `renovating`, `under_construction`, `unknown`. `unknown` means not verified — not closed. See “Status model”.

hotel_id_ref.title: hotel_id_ref
hotel_id_ref.description: For the 441 venues that also appear in hotels.public.csv, the hotel `id` that points here; empty otherwise. Lets readers reproduce the de-duplication behind the 6,146 headline.
